description: This file is a shell script that acts as a helper utility for launching diff and merge tools compatible with Git's external diff/mergetool interface. It manages prompting the user, selecting the appropriate tool, and executing it with relevant parameters.

methods.name: should_prompt
methods.description: Determines whether the diff/merge tool should prompt the user before launching based on Git configuration.

methods.name: use_ext_cmd
methods.description: Checks if an external command is specified to launch the diff/merge tool.

methods.name: launch_merge_tool
methods.description: Launches the specified merge tool with given files, prompting the user if configured.
